title: Owner Salary Normalization
description: Separates what a replacement manager would cost from an owner's total compensation package, producing comparable seller discretionary earnings and normalized EBITDA, plus a neutral reasonable-compensation pattern flag. Employer payroll taxes are the employer share only (IRC 3111), computed from the 2026 OASDI wage base when left at zero. Ported from Apex #158 to AINumbers art-755. Deterministic, zero external data, reads no clock.

reported_net_income.description: Reported pre-tax net income from the P&L, before any add-backs (USD). May be negative; the live page allows -100000000 to 1000000000. Default 180000. Read as a whole dollar: the kernel rounds on read.

one_time_expenses.description: One-time or non-recurring expenses a buyer would not expect to repeat (USD). Default 15000. Read as a whole dollar.

owner_count.description: Number of owners taking compensation. Rounded to a whole number and floored at 1, so 0 -> 1 and 1.5 -> 2. Default 1. Also drives replacement_cost_aggregate and per_owner_average_package, and sets multi_owner when greater than 1.

owner_w2_salary.description: Owner W-2 salary, the wages actually run through payroll (USD). Default 95000. Capped for OASDI only at min(owner_w2_salary, ss_wage_base); Medicare applies to the full figure.

owner_distributions.description: Owner distributions or draws, non-payroll cash taken out (USD). Default 60000.

employer_payroll_taxes_entered.description: Employer payroll taxes on owner wages (USD). Exactly 0 means 'compute it from ss_wage_base, ss_rate_pct and medicare_rate_pct'; any other value is used verbatim, including a negative. Default 0.

owner_health_insurance.description: Owner health insurance premiums paid by the company (USD). Default 14400.

owner_retirement_contribution.description: Owner retirement contribution by the company, employer side only (USD). Default 12000.

personal_vehicle_and_travel.description: Non-business personal vehicle and travel run through the company (USD). Default 9600.

other_personal_expenses.description: Other personal or discretionary expenses run through the company: meals, memberships, family payroll above market (USD). Default 6000.

market_wage_replacement_manager.description: Base wage it would cost to hire a replacement manager to do the owner's job (USD), before the benefits load. User-supplied market convention, not a statutory figure. Default 85000.

benefit_load_pct.description: Replacement manager benefits load as a percent of the wage: payroll taxes, insurance, retirement. User-supplied market convention. Clamped at 0. Default 22.

hours_per_week.description: Hours the owner works per week. Clamped at 0; exactly 0 suppresses the effective hourly rate. Default 55.

ss_wage_base.description: Social Security OASDI contribution and benefit base (USD). Default 184500, the 2026 figure from IRS Topic 751 and the SSA. Overridable so a prior or later year can be priced without editing the kernel.

ss_rate_pct.description: Employer Social Security rate, percent (IRC 3111(a)). Clamped at 0. Default 6.2.

medicare_rate_pct.description: Employer Medicare rate, percent (IRC 3111(b)). Clamped at 0. Default 1.45.

sde_multiple.description: SDE multiple used only for the valuation-impact line (x). User-supplied market convention. Clamped at 0. Default 2.8.

mcp_tool_definition.name: normalize_owner_salary
mcp_tool_definition.description: Normalizes a small-business owner's total compensation against the fully loaded cost of a replacement manager, producing seller discretionary earnings, normalized EBITDA, a normalization adjustment and a neutral reasonable-compensation pattern flag. Employer payroll taxes are computed from the 2026 OASDI wage base when not supplied. Deterministic, zero external data, reads no clock.

reported_net_income.description: Reported pre-tax net income from the P&L (USD)

one_time_expenses.description: Non-recurring expenses a buyer would not repeat (USD)

owner_w2_salary.description: Owner W-2 wages run through payroll (USD)

market_wage_replacement_manager.description: Base wage for a replacement manager (USD); user-supplied

benefit_load_pct.description: Benefits load on the replacement wage, percent; user-supplied

employer_payroll_taxes.description: Employer payroll taxes used: computed from the OASDI cap when employer_payroll_taxes_entered was exactly 0, otherwise the entered figure verbatim

employer_payroll_taxes_entered.description: True when the caller supplied an employer payroll tax figure and the computed branch was not taken

ss_taxable_wages.description: min(owner_w2_salary, ss_wage_base): the OASDI-capped wage base. Null when the caller entered payroll taxes.

employer_ss_tax.description: Employer Social Security tax on ss_taxable_wages, rounded to a whole dollar. Null when the caller entered payroll taxes.

employer_medicare_tax.description: Employer Medicare tax on the uncapped owner W-2, rounded to a whole dollar. Null when the caller entered payroll taxes.

total_owner_package.description: Owner W-2 + distributions + employer payroll taxes + health + retirement + personal vehicle + other personal

replacement_cost_single.description: Fully loaded cost of one replacement manager: round(market_wage * (1 + benefit_load_pct/100))

normalization_adjustment.description: total_owner_package - replacement_cost_aggregate; positive means the owner takes more than a replacement would cost

owner_effective_hourly_rate.description: total_owner_package / (hours_per_week * 52), rounded to a whole dollar. 0 when hours_per_week is 0.

owner_hourly_suppressed.description: True when hours_per_week is exactly 0 and the hourly rate is therefore not reported

owner_package_pct_of_replacement_bp.description: Owner package as a percent of replacement cost, in basis points. 0 when suppressed.

owner_package_pct_suppressed.description: True when replacement_cost_aggregate is 0 (a fully absentee owner needs no replacement), so the ratio is not reported

reasonable_comp_pattern_flag.description: Neutral pattern observation: true when owner W-2 is below 60% of replacement_cost_single AND distributions exceed W-2. Ungrounded heuristic, not a statutory test and not an accusation.

valuation_impact_at_multiple.description: normalization_adjustment * sde_multiple, rounded to a whole dollar

per_owner_average_package.description: total_owner_package / owner_count, rounded to a whole dollar

multi_owner.description: True when owner_count is greater than 1, i.e. replacement cost is an aggregate across owners

error.description: Always null. This kernel has no refusal branch: every input is optional and falls back to the live page default, so it never rejects a call.

regulatory_basis.description: Statutory basis with the URLs grounded on 2026-10-06

scope_note.description: Declared limits: employer share only, federal only, one year only, single replacement manager, pattern flag is not advice

warnings.description: Reader-facing mirror of the conditional compliance flags (AUTHORING-STANDARD 2.2): one sentence per raised condition, empty when none apply.

regulatory_citations: IRS Topic no. 751, 2026 Social Security wage base $184,500 — https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc751 (fetched 2026-10-06)
SSA Contribution and Benefit Base, 2026 $184,500 — https://www.ssa.gov/oact/cola/cbb.html (fetched 2026-10-06)
input_schema_provenance: REPORT ITEM for the trusted builder, not a settled choice. compute() reads all 17 inputs unconditionally on every call, but every read is wrapped in a default (Apex numOr/dollars), so no input is technically dereferenced-null and the kernel has no refusal branch. required is therefore declared on the four inputs that define WHAT IS BEING MEASURED rather than how it is benchmarked: without them the node silently prices the page defaults and the answer looks authoritative while being fictional. The 13 omitted inputs are genuinely optional because each has a defensible single default: the 12 add-back and wage inputs default to the live page's shipped values, and ss_rate_pct / medicare_rate_pct default to the statutory IRC 3111 rates. If the builder prefers a strict schema, the safe change is to make required the full 17 and add a refusal branch for missing values; that is a semantic change to compute() and would break the six live Apex vectors, which depend on the fallback behaviour.
